create_dataset_from_dict: create a Dataset from a Python dictionary with column names as keys and lists as values
create_dataset_from_pandas: create a Dataset from a pandas DataFrame with optional feature types and split name
map_transform_dataset: apply a function to all examples in a Dataset and update the table with new columns
filter_dataset: apply a filter function to keep only examples that match a condition in the Dataset
push_dataset_to_hub: push a Dataset to the Hugging Face Hub as Parquet files with optional sharding
